>
[Persona Mask](/Equipment.aspx?ID=451)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fortune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=76" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 613 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Despite covering the entire face, this alabaster mask does not hinder vision or other senses. Wearing the mask grants a +1 item bonus to Performance checks while acting, orating, performing comedy, or singing.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You change the mask’s appearance into an artistic rendition of a dramatic character of your choice.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Persona Mask
